name: recover_pose
description:
Move the right arm to a named recovery configuration while preserving the gripper command.
Use when: a planner or execution failure, or a poor configuration, makes ordinary waypoint correction inappropriate; choose previous to return to the arm joints measured at the start of the last admitted move_pose, or home to return to the arm joints measured at episode start.
Effect: world mutation along a global route to those joints, admitted and executed as move_pose describes for free_space; the torso stays where it is. One robot decision. Its path runs at move_pose's default speed, timed and wrist-checked as move_pose describes.
Returns: the submitted strategy; the next receipt and fresh observation report actual planning, residuals and preservation evidence. The later receipt separates refusal, arrival and recoverable non-arrival; available contact feedback includes requested versus measured motion, force/progress evidence and truthful unknown values.
Does not: reset the episode, restore moved objects or evaluator state, release the gripper, reverse an old trajectory, act as an emergency stop, or guarantee escape from contact.
On error: Refused: a strategy other than previous and home; an unknown field; the episode's terminal boundary (episode_terminal). An unavailable recovery state is not a refusal: the receipt reports plan_rejected with recovery_state_unavailable, as for previous before any arm motion; try the other strategy only when physically sensible, otherwise finish_episode names the accepted outcomes. Cost: previous undoes only the last arm motion, so the arm travels about as far as that action did; home travels to the start pose wherever the task stands and gives up the approach already made. Prefer previous when the last motion left a poor configuration; choose home only when the configuration before that motion is unusable too.

strategy.description: previous returns to the arm joints measured at the start of the last admitted move_pose; home returns to the arm joints measured at episode start.
